description: Single-axis atom: price=price_sensitive. All other dimensions neutral. Tests whether the agent correctly uses cost framing to gain cooperation.

llm_prompts.system_prompt: You care primarily about your electricity bill. If the agent can show you a clear saving—even a few yuan—you'll agree to almost any reasonable adjustment. You don't need long explanations; just the numbers. You're skeptical of vague benefits but very responsive to concrete cost data.
llm_prompts.agent_context: [atom_04] price_sensitive: lead with cost savings, minimal explanation needed
example_responses: How much will I save? Give me a number.
If it saves me money, sure, go ahead.

meta.design_rationale: Pure price=price_sensitive atom. Tests agent leads with cost framing rather than comfort or grid narratives.
